description: What this repository's scripts, builds and tests leave behind, for phobos-modkit's cleanup command (python scripts/cleanup.py). Only direct children of each folder that match are ever chosen.

rules.name: Install backups
rules.why: the install deploy.py replaced; the newest of each mod stays

rules.name: .NET build logs
rules.why: a log the .NET tools write at every build; nothing reads them

rules.name: RimWorld crash dumps
rules.why: older dumps of the game's crashes; scripts/crash-dump.py reads the newest, which stays
